features.name: Shield / Visibility
features.notes: Opt-in tracker / session-replay / advertising / fingerprint detection is enforced end-to-end client-side: a first-party (greenfield, MIT-clean) signature list feeds a pure shieldEngine classifier (classifyResource / runShieldScan with subdomain-safe matching, pixel-path heuristics, fingerprinting-API detection, de-dup + severity), surfaced via the ShieldVisibilitySettings scan UI (feature-toggle-shield-visibility) over the page's loaded performance resource entries. Detection only — nothing is blocked or signalled to third parties (ethics §4). Free baseline: features.shield.enabled is true on every tier, wired through the entitlements aggregation + a checkShieldEntitlements SDK gate. We deliberately do not bundle uBlock/EasyList rule sets (GPLv3/list-license). Form-exfil-before-submit warning and the webcam/mic permission audit remain follow-ups, so status is partial.
features.fallbackBehavior: When the shieldVisibility flag is off or the baseline entitlement is absent, the customization does not register / the scan control is disabled and the canonical shell renders unchanged.

features.name: Privacy Hardening
features.notes: Image perturbation is enforced end-to-end: the /v1/media/perturb route gates on features.hardening.imagePerturbation for the caller's tier (back-compat OR with the legacy privacy_tool grant) and an improved clean-room perturbation kernel (chroma-weighted, edge-gated, amplitude-clamped) runs client-side. A checkHardeningEntitlements SDK gate and useHardeningFeatures hook surface the tier. torTransport and decoyTraffic remain planned sub-capabilities (keys + gate only), so status is partial.
features.fallbackBehavior: When the privacyHardening flag is off or the pro entitlement is absent, the perturb control is disabled (Pro badge) and the server returns 402 perturbation_not_entitled; the canonical shell renders unchanged.

features.name: Persona Engine
features.notes: Active-persona roster cap is enforced server-side from the canonical PERSONA_QUOTAS for the caller's tier, with a client pre-flight gate (checkPersonaEntitlements) and usePersonaQuota hook. Clean-room HKDF per-conversation alias derivation, epoch rotation, and compartments are implemented (aliasDerivation.ts) and exposed via the rotate + roster endpoints with server-side rotation/compartment entitlement enforcement. The full compartment roster UI and cross-device persona-key sync remain pending, so status is partial.
features.fallbackBehavior: When the personaEngine flag is off or the capability is ungranted, the customization does not register and the canonical shell renders unchanged.

features.name: Active Defense
features.notes: Defensive, local-only deception primitives are enforced end-to-end: POST /v1/activedefense/canary-tokens mints opaque canary tokens, GET lists them with trip status, and POST /canary-tokens/trip records access; POST /v1/activedefense/decoy-data returns clearly-synthetic decoy records. Every mutating route gates on features.activedefense.* for the enterprise tier (402 active_defense_not_entitled otherwise) AND requires explicit admin consent (403 active_defense_consent_required). A checkActiveDefenseEntitlements SDK gate enforces tier + consent, and useActiveDefenseFeatures + the ActiveDefenseSettings surface gate the affordance behind a consent acknowledgement. No offensive, retaliatory, or third-party-directed behavior ships (ethics §4). Canary tripping is owner-scoped and the store is in-memory; a public tripwire route and persistence are tracked follow-ups, so status is partial.
features.fallbackBehavior: When the activeDefense flag is off or the enterprise entitlement is absent, the customization does not register and the server returns 402 active_defense_not_entitled; without explicit admin consent the server returns 403 active_defense_consent_required. The canonical shell renders unchanged.

features.name: Mesh / Offline Transport
features.notes: Store-and-forward peer sync (Briar-class) is enforced end-to-end with first-party greenfield gossip primitives — no Briar/Bramble code ships (GPLv3, reference-only; ethics §4). A pure mergeMeshEnvelopes implements epidemic store-and-forward (hop-count + TTL bounding, seenBy dedup/routing, expiry pruning) and is shared by the client and the server relay node. The server acts as one always-on mesh node: POST /v1/mesh/enqueue originates opaque end-to-end-encrypted envelopes, POST /v1/mesh/sync gossips with a peer (merge + offer-back), and GET /v1/mesh/inbox delivers. Every route gates on features.mesh.* for the enterprise tier (402 mesh_not_entitled otherwise); the relay never inspects payloads. A checkMeshEntitlements SDK gate + useMeshFeatures hook + the MeshTransportSettings surface (feature-toggle-mesh-transport, registered behind the meshTransport flag) front it. Local-radio/BLE/LoRa transport bridges and persistence are tracked follow-ups, so status is partial.
features.fallbackBehavior: When the meshTransport flag is off or the enterprise entitlement is absent, the mesh module does not register and the server returns 402 mesh_not_entitled; the canonical shell renders unchanged.

features.name: Transparency Reports
features.notes: Self-service transparency is enforced end-to-end: GET /v1/transparency/me returns the server-held self-report (subscription, active burner count, effective entitlements) and GET /v1/transparency/canary returns a dated warrant-canary statement with a sha256 tamper-evidence digest — both free. Org-scoped GET /v1/transparency/audit-export gates on features.transparency.auditExport (team+) and returns 402 audit_export_not_entitled otherwise. A checkTransparencyEntitlements SDK gate and useTransparencyFeatures hook surface the tier in the 'Your data' settings section. Cryptographic signing of the canary (vs. the current integrity digest) is a tracked follow-up, so status is partial.
features.fallbackBehavior: When the transparencyReports flag is off, no transparency surface registers and the canonical shell renders unchanged. When the auditExport entitlement is absent the export button is disabled (Team badge) and the server returns 402 audit_export_not_entitled.
